facts.fact: The Deputy Minister of Communications and Information Technology said the ministry runs a plan for digital capacity building of leaders and staff of the state administrative apparatus and had trained most of them, with 146,695 training certificates issued.
facts.system: MCIT digital literacy and capacity-building plan

facts.fact: The Deputy Minister said the ministry had finished training the majority of staff and leaders across the state administrative apparatus, 146,695 certificates in all.
facts.system: MCIT digital literacy and capacity-building plan

EGY.note: Digital literacy for villagers is described; no programme bringing internet access to rural areas or rural-urban use figures are stated.

facts.fact: The Deputy Minister said the ministry's digital literacy initiatives had raised digital awareness and skills for 1,122,837 citizens, including about 93,494 in first-phase Decent Life villages.

EGY.note: Capacity building for citizens with disabilities is named in a plan, with no accessible service, rule or delivery stated.
